name: no hot water, host silent
reason: There was no hot water for the whole 4-night stay.

evidence.content: Boiler control panel showing error code E9, timestamped on day 1
I messaged the host on day 1 and day 2 and got no reply. We showered at a gym.
Cleaner's checklist photos of every room, taken 2 hours before check-in, all spotless

name: advertised pool closed, host confirms
reason: The listing advertises a pool but it was closed for our whole stay.

evidence.content: Pool covered with a 'closed for repairs' sign
The pool was the main reason we chose this place.
Sorry, the pump broke the day before they arrived and I forgot to update the listing.

name: locked out first night, instructions were sent
reason: We could not get in on the first night and paid for a hotel.

evidence.content: The key box code didn't work. We arrived at 23:00 and the host didn't answer.
Hotel receipt for that night, EUR 140
Screenshot of check-in instructions sent 2 days earlier, with the key box code and a note that the code changes at 22:00

name: street noise disclosed in house rules
reason: Too noisy at night to sleep.

evidence.content: Bars on the street were loud until 2am every night.
The listing and house rules both say the flat is above a busy nightlife street and earplugs are provided.

name: bed bugs, host denies
reason: Bed bugs in the main bedroom.

evidence.content: Close-up of insects on the mattress seam, consistent with bed bugs
Bite marks on an arm the next morning
We have never had bed bugs.

name: host double-booked the flat
reason: On arrival someone else was staying in the apartment.

evidence.content: Another family was in the flat and had a booking from a different site.
My calendar didn't sync with the other site. I'm very sorry; the guest should get everything back.

name: slow wifi, speed test shows fine
reason: The wifi was too slow to work remotely.

evidence.content: Speed test from the router during the stay: 210 Mbps down, 40 up
